meta.description: Come as you are. LOVE SOPHIA JOY is a wholistic wellness, energy work and alchemy healing ministry with Kathleen Citrine from Laguna Beach — Heaven on Earth Energy Embodiment Flow, Heart Alchemy, and Light of Love transmissions.

blocks.title: Love Sophia Joy
blocks.subtitle: Let True Light Lead the Way to Miracles Every Day

blocks.title: Come as You Are.
openingParagraphs: We welcome you with open arms to LOVE SOPHIA JOY, a Wholistic Wellness Arts & Alchemy Healing Ministry. We are so very glad that you are here. Right now, we are sending you our love and golden good cheer. Can you feel this warm divine grace inside you, all around you so near? We can already see you smiling Divine Soul, you are so dear.
Several years ago, Christ Yeshua said to me:
closingParagraphs: I am, you are, we are all enough now, despite anything experienced in the past. Worthy enough. Deserving enough. Good enough. Beautiful enough. Smart enough. Strong enough. Capable enough. Uniquely, magnificently enough!

We are created from the energy of divine lovingjoy, sound & light — an emanation and ray of the One God Eternal Source — made manifest into consciousness and form. YOUR JOY is your gift, your strength, your power and your birthright. It is sacred; you are sacred. It is blessed; you are blessed. It is needed and valued; you are needed and valued. And you are allowed to be free and true, most wonderful you.

blocks.heading: Purpose
paragraphs: Connected to Eternal God Source and rooted in the pure heart center of Mother Earth, Kathleen & Sophia are on a quest to share our radiant wholehearted lovingjoy, our innate nature of miracles, soaring in synchronicity and lifting in liberation.
Through our conversations in Spirit after Sophia's transition out of her physical vessel, we are shown that there is no separation.

blocks.heading: Mission
paragraphs: The mission of LOVE SOPHIA JOY is to inspire, uplift and inpower wellbeing in all forms for all resonant Souls and, by virtue, our animal beloveds and all sentient Beings.

We aim to align coherence of mindbody, energy, emotions, heartsoul and spirit — to shine through weaving our wholistic wellness arts. We embrace, integrate and ignite the inner child so that Heaven right inside the heartsoul self — the Kingdom — can be realized.

blocks.heading: Process
paragraphs: We share our simple practices, tools and resources to achieve and sustain successful coherent alignment: loving, living, laughing, letting go, letting in, focusing, flowing and flourishing.

We do this organically yet organized — through the foundation of orchestrated intention, connection breath, sound, and movement. This encompasses our energy work and our artwork: Qigong, Reiki, Energy Work, Light Language, Art and Mother Earth Elements.
Through this process, we release all that we are not and remember the infinite abundance that we inherently already are. This catalyzes the revelation of freedom, health, wealth and happiness.

blocks.heading: Offerings & Services
paragraphs: Wholistic wellness arts woven for you — energy work (Reiki, Qigong, Heaven on Earth Flow, Heart Alchemy, Light of Love), creative sessions (Light Language, sacred art, visionary writing), and resources for your path home.

blocks.heading: Foundation
introParagraphs: The highest healing power and law is LOVE.
During a meditative rest and in a period where I was traversing, transmuting and transcending tremendous trauma, the warming voice of God Eternal Source spoke clearly to me:
blocks.firstQuote:
Forget all the laws that you know.
The only law that is real is love.
middleParagraphs: In this, I was reminded of who I AM and that my point of good faith and focus is formative in my experience. Anchoring in this Truth and Trust in myself brought me closer to Home in my heartsoul and in my mindbody. It gave me the ultimate lifeline and baseline.

I remembered my abilities to alchemize energy and hold the vision of others in their divine Soul Self, cleanse my subconscious mind, turning chaos to calm, terror to triumph, negation to creation, defeat to deliverance, depression to expression, victim to victor, entrapment to emergence, chasing to choosing, obstacles to opportunities, limits to leaps, mountains to miracles — and ultimately f.e.a.r. to love.
blocks.secondQuote: And God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
blocks.signoff: With wholehearted radiant lovingjoy, ~ Kathleen & Sophia
